Fixed-size.text: The application of deep learning methods to NLP is made possible by representing words as vectors in a low-dimensional continuous space. Traditionally, these word embeddings were static: each word had a single vector, regardless of context BIBREF0, BIBREF1. This suggests that, much like how upper layers of LSTMs produce more task-specific representations BIBREF4, upper layers of contextualizing models produce more context-specific representations.
